effectSummary: Quando um monstro adversário declara ataque, o oponente escolhe uma carta oculta da mão; se for um Monstro que possa ser Invocado por Invocação-Especial, é Invocado, caso contrário é enviado ao Cemitério.

design.handSource: only the defending team's current physical representative hand; inactive partner hand is not enumerated
design.chooser: the attacking team's current physical representative receives indistinguishable 'Carta oculta' tokens with no card IDs/names
design.reveal: the selected card is revealed to both teams after selection; all other cards in the hand remain private
design.summon: the resolver-provided legality callback decides whether the selected Monster can be Special Summoned; successful summon is face-up Attack Position in one of the three shared Monster Zones
design.fallback: non-monsters and monsters not summonable by this effect are planned for the shared Graveyard
design.mutation: adapter emits an immutable plan; central resolver performs atomic movement and attack replay

testCoverage: Trap physically owned by inactive partner but controlled by defending team
active defender hand versus inactive partner hand
summonable Monster to face-up Attack Position
no Monster in active hand activation gate

certification.reason: Adapter and tests are isolated; effect is not registered in the shared resolver because M61 handoff is pending.

limitations: Not registered in the main resolver or Discord handler; requires M61 handoff.
The central resolver must implement atomic movement and attack replay.
The legality callback must use the authoritative summon rules and 3 Monster Zone limit.
Offline adapter tests do not replace a live 2v2 duel or Discord API test.
